profile.headline: Software Engineer @ John Deere | Technical Engineering, Optimization
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer II at John Deere with over five years of experience, I specialize in web development, leveraging tools like React18, Spring Boot, and OpenAPI 3 to create impactful full-stack applications. My work includes designing and developing SAP BTP RAP and UI5 Fiori applications for dealer transition processes, setting up deployment pipelines with GitHub Actions and Cloud Foundry, and managing cloud-based front-end systems with BAS.  

With expertise in digital authentication, technical engineering, and optimization, I focus on delivering efficient and scalable solutions that enhance operational workflows and drive innovation. My contributions aim to support John Deere's commitment to optimizing processes and enabling impactful solutions for dealership operations.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Web development React18 fuel-react, JAVA Springboot API using OpenAPI 3
Designed and Developed Fiori ABAP RAP application on BTP cloud for dealer transition process around dealer consolidation, or dealer acquisition of equipment. Primarily using annotated CDS views and custom view entities requiring ABAP (RAP) to aggregate some API endpoints with local app tables.
•	Setup CTMS transport pipeline for asap dev -> prod
•	Setup and maintained Florida front-end using BAS and cloud deployment pipeline and managed repo in GitHub.
•	Developed GitHub actions deployment pipeline and cloud foundry to build and deploy front-end application.
•	Creation of tiles in catalog groups and managing roles and access to those tiles.
•	Second application was managing the dealer transition projects.
•	Using older WebIDE created and developed an app utilizing exposed CDS views in RB,WG and FI landscapes banking/accounting/loans and vehicle/inventory/management. 
•	Front-End Flori utilized oData but the app was custom and utilized significant amounts of JavaScript development.

positions.title: IT Analyst IV - Developer
positions.description:
•	SQL Queries, reverse engineering, database functions.
•	Profile UNIX scripting (Bash, Perl, Python)
•	Error handling, SFTP, VBA, HTML, SQL queries, and ability to troubleshoot stored procedures. 
•	Powershell, cmd and .bat files. 
•	Experience with GT.m and Profile script language psl (FIS)
•	Application of Statistical Principles in processing times for Asset Backed Securitization system (Moody’s)
•	Setup Tableau for Graphical Reporting, and Communication tools for Calendar views of Deployments.

positions.title: Advanced Material Replenishment Specialist
positions.description:
•	eKanban Implementation in 4630 Sprayer Assembly Line
•	John Deere, using MIDAS, ALiSS, FactoryFLOW, FlowPlanner
•	in AMS role, supporting ME with Part container quantities, locations, as well as access by material handlers, etc.
•	AMS Role, with custom racks, tuggers, tugger carts, kitting carts, supermarket racking and layouts, statistics and metrics displays, etc.

positions.title: Material Replenishment Specialist
positions.description:
I'm responsible for making sure every sprayer part is in the right place, at the right time, in the right container, with the right quantity, every time.

Created multi-route replenishment in new 300,000 sqft assembly building.
Developed Material handling standard work documentation
Became Power user for FactoryFLOW and FlowPlanner software
Developed Dock Door untilization systems
Developed Hybrid supermarket layout for picker optimization
3D factory Layout facilitation and standardization

positions.title: Manufacturing Engineer
positions.description:
This is a contract position through Volt Workforce Solutions as a contingent employee of John Deere Des Moines Works

•	Participated in new sprayer durability built Assigned to Knee Sub Assembly Cell.
•	Responsible for Containerization for Aspen/Denali/McKinley materials
•	Responsible for Virtual Build assembly line layout using FactoryCAD and VisView 3D modeling to be used floor-space allocation and virtual reality walkthrough, while incorporating extensive Lean manufacturing mindset.
•	Working with team on developing standardization of containers for Des Moines Works facility.
positions.insights: Skills: Oral Communication · Communication · Clarity · Knowledge Sharing · Interpersonal Skills · Analytical Skills

positions.title: Project Engineer
positions.description:
•	Managed all engineering design projects for company, up to 15 at a time.
•	Developed Proprietary tool box keyless entry system and utility truck body electrical door system
•	Responsible for Returns, Quality Assurance, All mechanical design aspects, Uprint 3D printer, and machine shop fixtureing. 
•	Worked in customer service which involved; keyless remotes, linear actuators.

positions.title: Continuous Improvement Coordinator
positions.description:
* Conducted 12 CI events in 3 months, Planned and organized the updates to 100+ pieces of standard work due to the implementation of Oracle Database System.
* Submitted monthly plant reports, presentations, Six-Sigma projects and cost savings totaling $500,000 in savings.
* Facilitated a massive TPM initiative for seven (7) “A” Level pieces of equipment.
* Managed the Continuous Improvement team in order to successfully run a minimum of one event per week.
* Initiated and managed a shop-floor problem solving program that in one month accumulated 27 improvement ideas.
* Visited several manufacturing facilities in order to participate and help with other plants improvements.
positions.insights: Skills: Oral Communication · Communication · Knowledge Sharing · Interpersonal Skills

positions.title: Lean Specialist
positions.description:
* Facilitated first Material Flow Event for Series 45 open circuit axial piston pumps. Reduce quarterback travel by 50%. Reduced inventory by 20%. Increased inventory turns by 20%.
* Co-facilitated several Value Stream Mapping Events, organized logistics for events (invitations, lunches, rooms, etc.), report-out presentations, schedule follow up meetings.
* Coached team members to continuously monitor and improve results.
* Facilitated S45 PFEP event for low-volume, high-variation assembly line. Included PFEP training.
* Facilitated CUT Easley valve move, and 2P event for new assembly station. Included 2P training.

positions.title: Industrial Engineer
positions.description:
* Electrolux Manufacturing System Coordinator for sheet metal press department. Lead 7 Week long events. Facilitated Training for 70+ operators and technicians. 
* Facilitated 5S, Visual Management, 1-piece-flow, standard work, kaizen, SMED training classes.
* Lead SMED events that produced 75% reduction in change over time (from 4 hours to 1 hour). 
* Observed processes for improvement opportunities, implemented creative suggestion system.
* Came in on weekends and facilitated 20+ weekend production team members.

positions.title: Manufacturing Engineer Intern
positions.description:
* Researched cutting-edge technologies of induction brazing in a controlled environment and ProModel® facility design simulation software, for Aerospace Fuel Nozzle manufacturer on the Aftermarket side of the business that is 1,943M size in dollars.
* Researched Unique Identification (UID) and laser marking applications with intent to increase traceability and reduce variances in human readable text. This will permit Goodrich the ability to revolutionize how information is stored and allows schedulers to know the exact location and operation of any part in the facility.
* Participated in Value Stream Mapping (VSM) event to reduce throughput and cycle time 14% with realigning cell equipment, stream lining processes, and implementing standard work.
* Reduced scrap for Honeywell manifold assembly by 78% which reflected in an annual savings of $20,000. This was done by using 6-sigma principles of adjusting tolerances while introducing visual and functional standards.

positions.title: Research Assistant & Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
This was for a CAD course that tought AutoCAD, AutoDesk Inventor and Pro/E.

The Research I was involved with was Low Cost Virtual Reality, where I helped setup, lecture and create virtual models for those purposes.
